title: Current String Template baseline
summary: String Template 0.1-dev2 is the current repository continuation. It preserves the dev1 interpolation language while adding non-executing requirement inspection, streaming render output, complete JSON control-byte escaping and consistent object-context name validation.
invariants: Template source is data and is never passed to INTERPRET.
The package is runtime authority; this sphere is continuity/documentation authority.
Native ooRexx values remain objects until a formatter produces textual output.
No runtime PASS is inferred from structural or standards checks.
